basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026 has 1 temporary/contractual Project Technical Support-III (Psychologist) position in the Division of Neonatology, Department of Pediatrics, AIIMS, New Delhi. The pay is 28,000/- + 30% HRA = 36,400/- per month. To apply, you need an MA/M.Phil in Psychology/Clinical Psychology, an MA/M.Phil in Rehabilitation Psychology, a Diploma in Rehabilitation Psychology or an equivalent qualification. Send your CV and attested certificates by email to [email protected] by 26 October 2026, 5:00 PM.

age_limit.details: The notice gives the age as 35 years. Upper age relaxation is allowed as per government rules/norms.

qualification.details: MA/ M.Phil in Psychology/ Clinical Psychology or MA/ M.Phil in Rehabilitation Psychology or Diploma in Rehabilitation Psychology or equivalent qualification.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: MA/ M.Phil in Psychology/ Clinical Psychology or MA/ M.Phil in Rehabilitation Psychology or Diploma in Rehabilitation Psychology or equivalent qualification. The following are listed as desirable. They are not required to apply: Advanced education (Master's/Doctorate in Psychology) Specialized training in psychometric testing Specific training in child-focused tools (e.g., DASII, BSID, WISC-V, VABS, WIPPSI) RCI Certified Experience in conducting child assessments You need at least one year of experience in the field, doing developmental assessments of high-risk children. The notice gives the age as 35 years. Upper age relaxation is allowed as per government rules/norms.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there for AIIMS New Delhi Project Technical Support-III (Psychologist)?
faq.answer: There is 1 position for Project Technical Support-III (Psychologist) in the Division of Neonatology, Department of Pediatrics, AIIMS, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Your application must be received by email by 26 October 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: You need an MA/ M.Phil in Psychology/ Clinical Psychology, an MA/ M.Phil in Rehabilitation Psychology, a Diploma in Rehabilitation Psychology or an equivalent qualification. You also need at least one year of experience doing developmental assessments of high-risk children.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age as 35 years. Upper age relaxation is allowed as per government rules/norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The salary is 28,000/- + 30% HRA = 36,400/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice adds 30% HRA to 28,000/-, which makes the total 36,400/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is not stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email your CV and attested copies of your certificates (date of birth, educational qualifications, experience) to [email protected]. Use the subject "Application for the post of ……………" with the post name filled in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice calls the post temporary/contractual and says it is purely temporary.
